theGoodProject.title: THE GOOD PROJECT
theGoodProject.description:
Every year, thousands of students pour months into a graduation project that reflects their own talents and everything their university invested to get them there.

Too often, that work gets presented once to a small panel and then disappears. That's why The GOOD News started The GOOD Project: a dedicated content pillar we publish annually, in graduation season, giving space to standout student ideas and the universities behind them.

In 3 years, The GOOD Project has reached an audience of 335,000 users, 2,210 students showcased 285 of their graduation projects. And like any project, we aim to keep developing it. This year, Misr International University joined us as our partner in success, celebrating their students' work alongside ours.

story.title: WHO WE ARE
story.content1: THE GOOD NEWS is a digital media platform founded by Mariam solika in 2020. We are dedicated to sharing positive stories, highlighting inspiring individuals, and fostering a community centered around hope and optimism.
story.content2: Mariam Solika — Founder and CEO of The Good News (TGN) and a United Nations Young Leader for the SDGs. In 2025, she became the youngest Egyptian ever to address the UN General Assembly, speaking at the historic 80th anniversary session of the UN Charter in New York. She has served as Youth Communications Consultant for COP27, COP28, and COP29, and was named UNICEF Egypt's "Most Inspiring Youth" in 2023. As the leading voice in positive, solutions-driven storytelling for Arab youth — locally, regionally, and globally — Mariam brings instant credibility and built-in reach through TGN's 300,000-strong community.
story.content3: From everyday heroes changing our lives, to creative initiatives and stories of social impact — THE GOOD NEWS exists to always remind you that there is still goodness and positive news waiting to be told.
story.missionContent: Our mission is to transform the media landscape by focusing on stories that celebrate human achievement, kindness, and progress. In a world often dominated by negative news, we strive to provide a balanced perspective by showcasing the good that exists all around us. We believe that positive journalism can inspire action, foster connection, and contribute to a more hopeful society.

caseStudies.title: Case Studies
caseStudies.description: Explore how our partnerships have created meaningful impact and positive change.

case1.description: TGN proudly serves as the digital arm of the Egyptian Ministry of Youth & Sports dedicated to amplifying governmental efforts related to Egyptian youth. Through innovative digital initiatives and strategic online engagement, TGN enhances the reach and impact of programs aimed at empowering and supporting the youth across Egypt.

case2.description: After successfully launching a targeted campaign featuring Egyptian Olympians, Palm Hills discovered a promising collaboration opportunity with THE GOOD NEWS a marketing mix that combines reels, quick news, and stories.

case3.description: Our partnership with Yalla Success was a perfect reflection of TGN's commitment of enabling real-world opportunities. Together, we launched a focused digital campaign aimed at aspiring female entrepreneurs across Egypt and the region. Through our storytelling approach we reached over 200,000 young people, sparking awareness and action. The campaign translated into 200+ program applications, proving that digital visibility, when built on trust and community, drives tangible results.

case4.title: Partnering with local NGOs to create sustainable community development programs
case4.description: Mountain View had a beautiful internal story, a piece of good news where they supported a young entrepreneur in their community. They could've gone mass. They could've gone overboard. But instead, they went niche, smart, and targeted, and the organic results spoke for themselves. Rather than blasting the story to every news agency, they chose the right home for positive storytelling in the region: THE GOOD NEWS.

case5.title: Partnering with local NGOs to create sustainable community development programs
case5.description: TGN's strategic collaboration with COP28 for the launch of the International Youth Climate Delegate Program significantly boosted youth engagement in Egypt. Leveraging its position as the exclusive Arab/Egyptian platform endorsed by COP28, TGN successfully drove participation, resulting in Egypt topping the list with over 1400 applications out of 11,000 globally. Notably, the endorsement from H.E. Shamma Al Mazrui, the UAE Minister of Community Development and COP28 Youth Climate Champion, added credibility and visibility to the initiative, amplifying its impact.

case6.title: Partnering with local NGOs to create sustainable community development programs
case6.description: As TGN is one of the most trusted platforms for youth in the Arab region, our retention rates for our collaboration with the Arab Youth Center were beyond impressive. Their news was the launch of the 5th edition of their program, the Young Arab Media Leaders, and of 50 selected members, 30% said they knew about the opportunity from TGN which showcases TGN's credibility and reach to younger audiences.

ourStory.title: Our Story
ourStory.subtitle: The Good Media Group (TGMG) is the parent company behind a growing ecosystem of media brands, original content, and community initiatives.
ourStory.p1: Our work sits at the intersection of storytelling, journalism, creativity, and impact—bringing together digital content, on-ground experiences, and strategic partnerships under one umbrella.
ourStory.p2: Whether we're producing a short-form news video, hosting a community event, or developing an original series, our goal remains the same: to create experiences that drive youth impact.

hope.title: Our Strategy and Framework
hope.subtitle: Our Strategy for Building the Leading Youth Ecosystem
hope.intro: Everything we build should help young people move from possibility to participation, from participation to potential, and from potential to leadership.
hope.hDesc: Through our News & Features, We tell stories that help young people see themselves in the future they want to build. By humanizing issues, challenges and successes through real people, we inspire action rather than passive optimism.
hope.oDesc: We connect young people with opportunities that accelerate their personal and professional journeys. We don't just inform — we create access. Our product line, Forsa Helwa, bridges the gap between youth and growth opportunities. We built a whole content series focused on equipping youth with skills that would help them grow.
hope.pDesc: We equip youth with the skills, confidence, networks and experiences they need to succeed. Through learning, community and mentorship, we help them become ready for what's next through The Good Space.
hope.eDesc: We create platforms where young people don't just consume stories — they shape them. We amplify youth voices, connect them with decision-makers and help them influence the future.
hope.journeySub: Every young person who engages with The Good Media Group should move through the same journey:
hope.stepH: Humanize → Discover stories that make the future feel possible.
hope.stepO: Open → Access opportunities that create momentum.
hope.stepP: Prepare → Gain the skills, confidence and community to grow.
hope.stepE: Elevate → Lead, create and shape the future for others.
hope.conclusion: Hope is not one pillar within this journey. Hope is what happens because all four pillars work together.
